8.3.2.2 LSduR_<User:Up>CancelTransmit
[CP_SWS_LSduR_91020] Definition of API function LSduR_<User:Up>Cancel
Transmit
Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
LSduR_<User:Up>CancelTransmit (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType LSduR_<User:Up>CancelTransmit (
PduIdType TxPduId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x4a
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.
Parameters (in)
TxPduId
Identification of the PDU to be cancelled.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the destination
module.
E_NOT_OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination module.
Description
Requests cancellation of an ongoing transmission of a PDU in a lower layer communication
module.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
⌋
